description: S05d (expanded scope approved by the user on 2026-10-24, review docs/施工/发布慢因与施工方案审查.md section 4 row 1): make preparation-stage failures stop blocking the whole queue, as a general mechanism for future executor behaviour. (1) Structured terminal: deterministic rejections are recorded as a dispatched 'failed' terminal with bound evidence instead of 'unknown'. (2) Preparation-stage unknown: after fail-closed eligibility checks the queue writes a separate abandonment record that marks the old packet as never-to-be-consumed, leaves the original unknown bytes untouched, and lets the next ticket prepare (even the same target) in a NEW packet directory. Publication/deploy-stage unknown (any STARTED/SUCCESS/FAILED/WorkerApply/maintenance marker in the attempt dir) stays blocking. Never forge FAILED/SUCCESS/resolution for existing unknowns; the abandonment record honestly states 'outcome unknown, packet retired'. All work in the scratch repo D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\repo.
steps: Read first: docs/施工/发布慢因与施工方案审查.md (sections 2.1, 3.3, 4), docs/施工/执行约定.md (恢复与长任务), tools/main-prebuild-queue.mjs (whole file), tools/publish-latest-main.mjs (whole file), tools/publish-main.mjs (main() and its catch), tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs lines 60-360 (prepare-only path, FAILED-<uuid>.json write near line 348), tools/preparation-retirement-admission.mjs, tests/main-prebuild-queue-v2.test.mjs (fixture helpers to reuse).

Compatibility check before coding: grep tools/preparation-retirement*.mjs, tools/preparation-resolution*.mjs, tools/main-prebuild-status.mjs, tools/install-main-prebuild.mjs, tools/main-control-dispatch.mjs for 'prebuild-queue-v2' and readdir of the queue root, and confirm a new queue leaf directory 'abandoned' (and the new terminal shape) will not be rejected by any reader on the normal consumer/deploy path (withRetirementReadScope, assertRetirementAdmission, status, installer census). If a reader enumerates the queue root strictly, extend it minimally and add a test; record the evidence in findings.

(1a) Native side, tools/publish-main.mjs: in --prepare-only mode with --result-file, validate the result-file path (dirname must equal <packet>/invocations, must not exist) at the start of main(); in the top-level failure path, if prepare-only and the validated result file still does not exist, write it once (flag 'wx') as canonical-enough JSON {version:'teruisi-native-preparation-failure-v1',status:'preparation-failed',mainCommit:<request.mainCommit or null if request unreadable>,publicationPerformed:false,publicationStarted:false,maintenanceStarted:false,phase:<last phase label or 'native-entry'>,error:<message sliced to 1600>,failureReceipt:<{path,sha256} of preparation/FAILED-<uuid>.json when publishPreparedMain wrote one, else null>}. In tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs attach the FAILED-<uuid>.json path to the thrown error (e.g. error.preparationFailureFile) when it writes it; do not change any other behaviour. Never write this record in deploy mode; prepare-only never writes STARTED.json.

(1b) Control side, tools/publish-latest-main.mjs runPublisher: only when args include '--prepare-only', on non-zero exit read the invocation result file if present and validate it strictly (exact key set, version, status 'preparation-failed', publicationPerformed/publicationStarted/maintenanceStarted all false, mainCommit null or the expected target read from <packet>/main-release-request.json, failureReceipt null or {path inside <packet>/publish-<target12>/preparation, sha256 matching current bytes}). If valid, throw an Error carrying error.preparationTerminal={kind:'native-preparation-failed',resultFile,resultSha256,phase}. If missing or invalid, keep today's plain Error (-> unknown).

(1c) tools/publish-latest-main.mjs drainLatestMainQueue prepare callback: errors thrown by the consumer's own code BEFORE runPublisher is called (once(), writeMainPreparationPointer, inspect, reuse checks) get error.preparationTerminal={kind:'rejected-before-native',stage:<short label>} because no native process was started. Errors from runPublisher keep only what (1b) attaches.

(1d) tools/main-prebuild-queue.mjs: when prepare throws with a preparationTerminal of a known kind and valid shape, write the ticket terminal as status 'failed' WITH dispatch refs: {...base, dispatchId, dispatchSha256, selectedTarget, winnerRequestId, error, preparationTerminal}. Extend ticketResult: the old pre-dispatch 'failed' shape (base+error) stays valid unchanged; the new dispatched 'failed' shape validates the dispatch binding exactly like 'unknown' does, validates preparationTerminal (kind in the closed set; for native: resultFile absolute and directly inside dispatch.selection.packet/invocations, resultSha256 hex and equal to the current file bytes). Unknown kinds or extra keys fail closed.

(2a) tools/main-prebuild-queue.mjs: add queue leaf 'abandoned/<dispatchId>.json' (create lazily, do not add it to initializeQueue's required set unless needed). Record (durableCreate, canonical): {version:'teruisi-preparation-abandonment-v1',dispatchId,dispatchSha256,winnerRequestId,selectedTarget,packet:dispatch.selection.packet,originalResultSha256:<sha of the winner's canonical unknown terminal bytes>,at,basis:{deadlineUnixMs:dispatch.deadlineUnixMs,graceMs,publicationMarkersChecked:[...names],preparedReceiptPresent:<bool>,rotationLockFree:true},consumePermitted:false}. readPreparationQueueInventory validates every abandonment record against its dispatch and terminal (orphan, mismatch, extra keys, non-unknown terminal -> throw) and returns them.

(2b) Eligibility, evaluated under the queue lock only when drainPreparationQueue receives an explicit option (e.g. abandonment:{graceMs,probeRotationLock,inspectAttempt}); without the option behaviour is exactly as today so existing tests and legacy semantics stay. Eligible only if ALL hold: every ticket of the dispatch has terminal 'unknown' and readPreparationResolution did not resolve it; Date.now() >= dispatch.deadlineUnixMs + graceMs (default graceMs 15 min); inspectAttempt reports that <packet>/publish-<target12> contains none of STARTED.json, SUCCESS.json, FAILED.json, WorkerApply-started.json, maintenance-first-FAILED.json (missing directory counts as none); probeRotationLock() returns true (real default in publish-latest-main: listen on '\\.\pipe\TERUISI.Worker.ReleaseRotation.v1' then close; EADDRINUSE -> false; any other error -> false). Otherwise the dispatch keeps blocking with today's message. Call invalidateRetirementScope('queue-abandonment-write') before writing.

(2c) Blocking loop: a dispatch whose tickets all have the new dispatched 'failed' terminal, or whose unknown terminals have a valid abandonment record, does not block. resolutionForbidsTargetReplay is unchanged for resolution-based dispatches; failed/abandoned dispatches do not forbid their target.

(3) New packet directory: add one exported pure helper (e.g. in main-prebuild-queue.mjs) returning the set of retired packet paths (dispatch.selection.packet of failed-dispatched and abandoned dispatches) and a helper choosing the packet: base '<target12>-<liveBinding8>-<django8>' if not retired, else '<base>-r2', '-r3', ... first not retired (cap 64, then throw). observeLatestMain must use it (pass the retired set from the inventory the consumer already holds under lock; deploy/check paths in runLatestMainCli read the inventory read-only to compute the same set). prepareLatestMainOnce must accept selection.packet whose basename is base or base-rN (N>=2) instead of asserting equality with base, and use 'codex/manual-main-'+basename(packet) as the worktree branch. deployReadyMain/inspectMainPreparation must refuse a retired packet. grep the repo tools for other derivations of the packet name (slice(0,12)+'-' with bindingSha256.slice(0,8)) e.g. main-prebuild-status.mjs, publish-main-status.mjs, release-preparation-evidence.mjs and keep them consistent.
(4) Wire the real abandonment option and probe in drainLatestMainQueue only (control path).

(5) Tests: new tests/main-prebuild-queue-abandonment.test.mjs reusing the fixture style of tests/main-prebuild-queue-v2.test.mjs (no child processes, so it runs in the sandbox). Cover: native-preparation-failed -> dispatched 'failed', next ticket proceeds into '<base>-r2'; rejected-before-native -> failed and proceeds; unknown before deadline+grace stays blocked; after it, abandonment record written, original results/*.json bytes unchanged, same target prepared again in '-r2'; STARTED.json (and each other marker) in the attempt dir -> never abandoned; rotation probe false -> not abandoned; tampered/orphan abandonment record and invalid preparationTerminal (bad kind, extra key, sha mismatch, resultFile outside invocations) -> fail closed; without the abandonment option the old blocking behaviour is unchanged. Add focused unit tests for the runPublisher result-file validator and the packet-slot helper (export them for testing) in a sandbox-runnable file (NOT tests/publish-latest-main.test.mjs, whose fixture spawns git and hangs here; importing tools/publish-latest-main.mjs itself spawns nothing). Each test must fail if the corresponding new code is reverted.

Run node --check on every changed .mjs; run run-test.ps1 for main-prebuild-queue-abandonment main-prebuild-queue-v2 main-prebuild-generation-rejection publish-latest-main main-prebuild-status (plus any other test that imports a changed file; find them with Select-String over tests/*.mjs). Compare with FEAT-001 baseline; any new failure that is not sandbox-limited must be fixed.

Commit in the scratch repo only: $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL'; & D:\git\Git\cmd\git.exe -c safe.directory=* -c user.name=Codex -c user.email=codex@openai.com -C D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\repo add <only the files you changed> ; then commit -m 'S05d: structured preparation terminals and abandonment of preparation-stage unknown'. List committed files and the commit hash in findings, plus which tests are sandbox-limited and must be re-run outside the sandbox.
acceptance_criteria: A prepare() failure carrying a valid preparationTerminal is written as a dispatched 'failed' terminal and does not block later tickets; a plain failure is still 'unknown'
An unknown dispatch is abandoned only when all eligibility conditions hold; the abandonment record is validated on every inventory read; the original unknown result file is byte-identical
After failure/abandonment the next preparation of the same target uses '<base>-r2' and the deploy path resolves the same packet and refuses retired packets
Without the new option, all pre-existing queue tests keep their results from the FEAT-001 baseline
New test file passes in the sandbox runner; node --check passes on all changed files

findings: Commit 24dd52ac6272ee3e16412c0a125844de883fce3c on codex/release-rework-20261024 (parent a6cc9fcd) in scratch repo D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\repo, identity Codex <codex@openai.com>. Committed files: tools/main-prebuild-queue.mjs, tools/publish-latest-main.mjs, tools/publish-main.mjs, tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs, tests/main-prebuild-queue-abandonment.test.mjs (new), tests/publish-main-preparation-failure.test.mjs (new), tests/publish-prepared-main.test.mjs (one existing test extended). git status clean after commit. DESIGN: (1a) publish-main.mjs validates --result-file at main() start only in --prepare-only (dirname == <packet>/invocations, must not exist); main().catch writes once (wx) {version teruisi-native-preparation-failure-v1, status preparation-failed, mainCommit (request.mainCommit if 40-hex else null), publicationPerformed/publicationStarted/maintenanceStarted false, phase (error.preparationPhase or 'native-entry'), error<=1600, failureReceipt {path,sha256}|null}; never in deploy mode; skipped if the success result already exists. publish-prepared-main.mjs only attaches error.preparationFailureFile and error.preparationPhase when it writes preparation/FAILED-<uuid>.json (no other behaviour change). (1b) publish-latest-main.mjs exports readNativePreparationFailure(resultFile,packet): exact key set, version/status, three falses, phase/error bounds, mainCommit null or == <packet>/main-release-request.json mainCommit, failureReceipt null or exact {path,sha256} inside <packet>/publish-<t12>/preparation, FAILED-<uuid>.json name, sha of current bytes; any deviation -> null. runPublisher attaches error.preparationTerminal only for --prepare-only non-zero exits with a valid record; otherwise the same plain Error as before (-> unknown). (1c) drainLatestMainQueue wraps once/pointer-write/inspect/reuse-check with stage labels freeze-source/pointer-write/inspect/reuse-check -> {kind:'rejected-before-native',stage}; runPublisher errors and post-native asserts are untouched. (1d) Queue writes status 'failed' WITH dispatch refs + preparationTerminal only when validatePreparationTerminal passes (closed kinds; native resultFile directly in dispatch.selection.packet/invocations with uuid name, sha equals current bytes; extra keys/kinds fail) AND inspectPreparationAttempt finds no publication marker (extra safety: a STARTED beside a structured failure stays unknown). ticketResult: old pre-dispatch failed shape unchanged; new dispatched failed shape validates dispatch binding like unknown plus preparationTerminal on every read. (2a) New lazily created leaf prebuild-queue-v2/abandoned/<dispatchId>.json (durableCreate canonical) exactly as specified (basis.publicationMarkersChecked = STARTED.json, SUCCESS.json, FAILED.json, WorkerApply-started.json, maintenance-first-FAILED.json; consumePermitted false). readPreparationQueueInventory validates each record (orphan, name, dispatch sha, winner, target, packet, basis keys, at >= deadline+grace, all tickets unknown of that dispatch, originalResultSha256 == canonical winner terminal sha) and returns inventory.abandonments. (2b) Only when drainPreparationQueue gets abandonment:{probeRotationLock (required fn), graceMs (default 15 min), inspectAttempt (default inspectPreparationAttempt), now (default Date.now, for tests)}: every ticket unknown, no resolution, now >= deadline+grace, attempt dir contains nothing except 'preparation' and 'LEASE-WARNING.json' (stricter than the 5 named markers: any resume-*, maintenance-admission.json, publication-materials-* etc also block; missing dir = none; inspect errors = not eligible), probe returns exactly true (throw/false = not eligible). invalidateRetirementScope('queue-abandonment-write') before writing; after writing the loop re-reads the inventory. Without the option nothing is evaluated (legacy). (2c) dispatched-failed and abandoned dispatches do not block; resolutionForbidsTargetReplay unchanged; they ban no target. (3) Exported pure helpers in main-prebuild-queue.mjs: retiredPreparationPackets(inventory) (lower-cased resolved packet keys), isRetiredPacket, preparationPacketSlot(releaseDirectory,base,retired) (base, then -r2..-r64, then throw), assertPreparationPacket. observeLatestMain takes retiredPackets and uses the slot helper (slot 1 string identical to the old path.join, so existing reuse comparisons keep working); queue passes observe({retiredPackets}) from the inventory under lock and rejects (pre-dispatch failed) a retired selection; prepareLatestMainOnce accepts base or base-rN, worktree branch 'codex/manual-main-'+basename; inspectMainPreparation/deployReadyMain refuse retired packets; runLatestMainCli check/deploy computes the same set via readRetiredPackets(config) (deploy under the queue lock; empty when no v2 queue). No other packet-name derivation in tools besides publish-latest-main (publish-main-status, main-prebuild-status accept any packet name). (4) drainLatestMainQueue passes abandonment with probeRotationLock() = listen+close on \\.\pipe\TERUISI.Worker.ReleaseRotation.v1 (EADDRINUSE/any error -> false); injectable probeRotation/abandonmentGraceMs. COMPATIBILITY EVIDENCE: queue-root readers only enumerate tickets/dispatches/results/resolutions leaves; the production queue root already holds runner-*.log files, so a new 'abandoned' leaf is not rejected by any reader; install-main-prebuild nativeOperationBindings enumerates packets of any name; preparation-retirement-admission reads preparation-retirements (absent in production). Read-only run of the NEW readPreparationQueueInventory against the production queue (no writes): 85 tickets, 33 dispatches, terminals unknown 10/blocked 50/prepared 19/failed 2/non-production 4, abandonments 0, retired set empty; a3d53227 has 1 ticket 'unknown', deadline 2026-10-22T08:11:22Z, packet attempt has only preparation/ (markers [], PREPARED absent), so after control adoption it would be abandoned if no resolution and the rotation lock is free. KNOWN LIMITS (recorded, not changed): tools/preparation-retirement-entry.mjs pins exact bytes of publish-latest-main.mjs (currentLatest 1fa234d5...) and publish-main.mjs (main list incl. 228e1512...); this commit changes both, so the per-case retirement collector would reject sources carrying the new bytes until re-qualified (the general abandonment path makes that flow unnecessary for preparation-stage unknowns). tools/preparation-retirement-ref.mjs ref fence and preparation-retirement-collector nativeFrozen regex only match base-name 'codex/manual-main-<12>-<8>-<8>' branches; -rN branches are still guarded in-process by assertRetirementAdmission before worktree creation. check mode reads the inventory without the queue lock, so a concurrent partial write can fail a check (fail closed, no deploy).
